name: LAMMPS
description: Builds LAMMPS stable_30Sep2026_update1 (lmp) into /opt/wise with the image's MPI, FFTW, OpenBLAS and the OPENMP package. With kokkosCudaArch it also builds KOKKOS for that GPU with cuFFT from the CUDA base image.

kokkosCudaArch.description: Kokkos GPU architecture (Kokkos_ARCH_<value>); requires the CUDA base image. Empty builds the CPU-only binary.
